name: Adriana
note: Paired with Sf. Adrian și Natalia (08-26) by root-name convention, not an independently attested female saint.

name: Anca
note: Treated in Romanian practice as a short form of Ana (07-25).

name: Anton
note: Short form of Antonie, paired with Sf. Antonie cel Mare (01-17).

name: Antonia
note: Feminine of Antonie; root-name convention.

name: Cătălin
note: Paired with Sf. Mc. Ecaterina (11-25) by root-name convention, via Cătălina.

name: Cătălina
note: Romanian derivative of Ecaterina; root-name convention.

name: David
note: The Sf. Proroc David feast is technically the movable 'Sunday after Nativity' (with Iosif and Iacov), not a fixed date — doesn't fit the MM-DD/easter±N grammar. Popular media conventionally cite 26 December as fixed; used here as an approximation.

name: Denisa
note: Only one source found (calendarbisericesc.ro), linking Denisa to Sf. Dionisie; same source also mentions 17 December as an alternate. Needs a second independent source before shipping.

name: Emil
note: Paired with Sf. Emilian de la Durostorum (07-18) by root-name convention; a second Sf. Emilian Mărturisitorul is celebrated 08-08 — sources are split between two distinct saints named Emilian, so this is convention, not a direct match.

name: Florentina
note: Part of the 'Florii' group of flower-derived names (with Florin, Viorel, Viorica) — confirmed by g4media.ro's list of names celebrated on Florii.

name: Florin
note: Florii is a movable group celebration for flower-derived names — Florin is the single most common name in that group (~335,000 Romanians per g4media.ro).

name: Georgeta
note: Feminine of Gheorghe; same convention as Georgiana.

name: Georgiana
note: One low-quality search hit suggested 15 April for Georgiana; could not confirm it against any named source, so rejected in favor of the standard root-name convention (Gheorghe, 04-23).

name: Grigore
note: Sf. Grigore Teologul (01-25). Also commemorated 30 January with the Trei Ierarhi; the 25 January feast is the one specific to the name.

name: Ignat
note: Romanian short form of Ignatie; Sf. Mc. Ignatie Teoforul (12-20), the day of the traditional Ignatul porcilor.

name: Ilinca
note: Feminine derived from Ilie; paired with Sf. Prooroc Ilie (07-20).

name: Mădălina
note: Romanian derivative of Magdalena; root-name convention.

name: Nicoleta
note: Feminine of Nicolae, paired with Sf. Nicolae (12-06) by root-name convention, not an independently attested female saint.

name: Niculina
note: Feminine of Nicolae; same convention as Nicoleta.

name: Oana
note: Treated in Romanian practice as a short form of Ioana (01-07). One source (calendarbisericesc.ro) instead cites 02 December, tied to a different sinaxar entry — sources disagree, flagging.

name: Parascheva
note: The sinaxar spelling of the name already seeded as Paraschiva; both forms are in common use, so both are listed.

name: Petre
note: Romanian variant of Petru; Sf. Ap. Petru și Pavel (06-29).

name: Radu
note: Feast of the Brâncoveanu martyrs (Sf. Constantin Brâncoveanu și fiii săi, incl. Radu) — 16 August.

name: Sânziana
note: Folk name tied to Sânziene, numele popular al sărbătorii Nașterea Sf. Ioan Botezătorul (06-24). Not a sinaxar entry.

name: Simion
note: Romanian form of Simeon; Sf. Simeon și Ana (02-03).

name: Ștefania
note: Feminine of Ștefan; paired with Sf. Arhidiacon Ștefan (12-27).

name: Teodor
note: Sf. Mc. Teodor Tiron (02-17). A second Sf. Teodor Stratilat falls on 08 February — sources split between the two; 17 February is the more widely cited nameday.

name: Teodora
note: Feminine of Teodor; root-name convention.

name: Vasilica
note: Feminine of Vasile; paired with Sf. Vasile cel Mare (01-01) by root-name convention, not an independently attested saint.

name: Viorel
note: Part of the 'Florii' group of flower-derived names, alongside Florin and Florentina.

name: Viorica
note: Part of the 'Florii' group of flower-derived names, alongside Florin and Florentina.
